lines: // Check two exact equalities in base ten: N*units = abs(floor)*D + R and D = R + gap.
// The positive gap proves the division remainder is in range. Comparing R with gap
// establishes whether the amount is below, at, or above the half-unit tie.
.decl digit_cell(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number, digit: number, last: symbol)
digit_cell(l, k, p, d, last) :- rounding_digit(r), rounding_digit__line(r, l),
rounding_digit__part(r, k), rounding_digit__position(r, p), rounding_digit__digit(r, d),
rounding_digit__last(r, last), p >= 0, d >= 0, d <= 9.
.decl digit_at(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number)
digit_at(l, k, p) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, _, _).
.decl bad_digits(line: symbol)
bad_digits(l) :- rounding_digit__line(r, l), rounding_digit__digit(r, d), d < 0.
bad_digits(l) :- rounding_digit__line(r, l), rounding_digit__digit(r, d), d > 9.
bad_digits(l) :- rounding_digit__line(r, l), rounding_digit__position(r, p), p < 0.
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, d, _), digit_cell(l, k, p, other, _), d != other.
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, _, a), digit_cell(l, k, p, _, b), a != b.
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, _, _), p > 0, rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, _), !digit_at(l, k, before).
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, _, "more"), rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), !digit_at(l, k, after).
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, k, p, _, "last"), rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), digit_at(l, k, after).
bad_digits(l) :- digit_cell(l, _, p, 0, "last"), p > 0.
// Only the original signed minor-unit factor and candidate floor use machine words.
// Their supplied suffixes are checked with constant division and must terminate.
.decl word_cell(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number, remaining: number)
word_cell(l, k, p, n) :- rounding_word(r), rounding_word__line(r, l),
rounding_word__part(r, k), rounding_word__position(r, p), rounding_word__remaining(r, n), p >= 0.
.decl word_at(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number)
word_at(l, k, p) :- word_cell(l, k, p, _).
.decl word_step(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number, next: number, digit: number)
word_step(l, k, p, next, digit) :- word_cell(l, k, p, n),
next = n / 10, tens = next * 10, digit = n - tens.
.decl bad_words(line: symbol)
bad_words(l) :- word_cell(l, k, p, a), word_cell(l, k, p, b), a != b.
bad_words(l) :- word_cell(l, k, p, _), p > 0, rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, _), !word_at(l, k, before).
bad_words(l) :- word_step(l, k, p, next, _), next != 0, rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), !word_cell(l, k, after, next).
bad_words(l) :- word_step(l, k, p, 0, _), rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), word_at(l, k, after).
.decl word_digit(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number, digit: number)
word_digit(l, k, p, d) :- word_step(l, k, p, _, d), d >= 0.
word_digit(l, k, p, magnitude) :- word_step(l, k, p, _, d), d < 0, magnitude = 0 - d.
.decl coefficient(line: symbol, equation: symbol, position: number, part: symbol, offset: number, value: number)
coefficient(l, "division", p, "numerator", j, v) :- digit_cell(l, "numerator", i, a, _),
word_digit(l, "units", j, b), p = i + j, v = a * b.
coefficient(l, "division", p, "denominator", j, v) :- digit_cell(l, "denominator", i, a, _),
word_digit(l, "floor", j, b), p = i + j, product = a * b, v = 0 - product.
coefficient(l, "division", p, "remainder", 0, v) :- digit_cell(l, "remainder", p, d, _), v = 0 - d.
coefficient(l, "complement", p, "denominator", 0, d) :- digit_cell(l, "denominator", p, d, _).
coefficient(l, "complement", p, "remainder", 0, v) :- digit_cell(l, "remainder", p, d, _), v = 0 - d.
coefficient(l, "complement", p, "gap", 0, v) :- digit_cell(l, "gap", p, d, _), v = 0 - d.
// Each product coefficient has at most 19 terms from a signed BIGINT word.
// A carry of at most 512 covers both products and the remainder without bounding N or D.
.decl carry_cell(line: symbol, equation: symbol, position: number, value: number)
carry_cell(l, e, p, v) :- rounding_carry(r), rounding_carry__line(r, l),
rounding_carry__equation(r, e), rounding_carry__position(r, p), rounding_carry__carry(r, v),
.decl carry_at(line: symbol, equation: symbol, position: number)
carry_at(l, e, p) :- carry_cell(l, e, p, _).
// The arithmetic uses ordinary bounded indices. Materialize neighbors so each
// missing-position check has an independently bound key.
.decl rounding_neighbor(line: symbol, position: number, before: number, after: number)
rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, after) :- digit_at(l, _, p), before = p - 1, after = p + 1.
rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, after) :- word_at(l, _, p), before = p - 1, after = p + 1.
rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, after) :- carry_at(l, _, p), before = p - 1, after = p + 1.
rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, after) :- coefficient(l, _, p, _, _, _), before = p - 1, after = p + 1.
.decl bad_carry(line: symbol)
bad_carry(l) :- carry_cell(l, e, p, a), carry_cell(l, e, p, b), a != b.
bad_carry(l) :- carry_cell(l, e, p, _), p > 0, rounding_neighbor(l, p, before, _), !carry_at(l, e, before).
bad_carry(l) :- carry_cell(l, e, p, a), a != 0, rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), !carry_at(l, e, after).
bad_carry(l) :- coefficient(l, e, p, _, _, _), !carry_at(l, e, p).
bad_carry(l) :- coefficient(l, e, p, _, _, _), rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), !carry_at(l, e, after).
// A successful equality has a positive witness for every column, including its
// sum contributors, as well as closed-world checks on the shape of the chain.
.decl checked_column(line: symbol, equation: symbol, position: number)
checked_column(l, e, p) :- carry_cell(l, e, p, a), rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), carry_cell(l, e, after, b),
total = sum item : { coefficient(l, e, p, _, _, item) }, lhs = total + a, rhs = b * 10, lhs = rhs.
// A prefix contains only columns with checked sums. Following those positive
// premises exposes each column's evidence in a single amount-difference proof.
.decl checked_prefix(line: symbol, equation: symbol, position: number)
checked_prefix(l, e, 0) :- carry_cell(l, e, 0, 0).
checked_prefix(l, e, after) :- checked_prefix(l, e, p), checked_column(l, e, p),
rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after).
.decl checked_equation(line: symbol, equation: symbol)
checked_equation(l, e) :- checked_prefix(l, e, p), carry_cell(l, e, p, 0),
rounding_neighbor(l, p, _, after), !carry_at(l, e, after).
.decl gap_positive(line: symbol)
gap_positive(l) :- digit_cell(l, "gap", _, d, _), d > 0.
.decl comparison_position(line: symbol, position: number)
comparison_position(l, p) :- digit_at(l, "remainder", p).
comparison_position(l, p) :- digit_at(l, "gap", p).
.decl comparison_digit(line: symbol, part: symbol, position: number, digit: number)
comparison_digit(l, "remainder", p, d) :- digit_cell(l, "remainder", p, d, _).
comparison_digit(l, "remainder", p, 0) :- comparison_position(l, p), !digit_at(l, "remainder", p).
comparison_digit(l, "gap", p, d) :- digit_cell(l, "gap", p, d, _).
comparison_digit(l, "gap", p, 0) :- comparison_position(l, p), !digit_at(l, "gap", p).
.decl unequal_digit(line: symbol, position: number, remainder: number, gap: number)
unequal_digit(l, p, a, b) :- comparison_digit(l, "remainder", p, a), comparison_digit(l, "gap", p, b), a != b.
.decl later_unequal_digit(line: symbol, position: number)
later_unequal_digit(l, p) :- unequal_digit(l, p, _, _), unequal_digit(l, later, _, _), later > p.
.decl unequal_magnitudes(line: symbol)
unequal_magnitudes(l) :- unequal_digit(l, _, _, _).
.decl half_position(line: symbol, side: symbol)
half_position(l, "below") :- unequal_digit(l, p, a, b), a < b, !later_unequal_digit(l, p).
half_position(l, "above") :- unequal_digit(l, p, a, b), a > b, !later_unequal_digit(l, p).
half_position(l, "tie") :- expected_line(l), !unequal_magnitudes(l).
.decl signed_floor(line: symbol, sign: symbol, floor: number)
signed_floor(l, "negative", f) :- expected_line__sign(l, "negative"), expected_line__floor_minor(l, f), f <= 0.
signed_floor(l, "nonnegative", f) :- expected_line__sign(l, "nonnegative"), expected_line__floor_minor(l, f), f >= 0.
.decl rounding_mode(terms: symbol, mode: symbol)
rounding_mode(t, "half_even") :- rounding__mode(t, "half_even").
rounding_mode(t, "half_up") :- rounding__mode(t, "half_up").
.decl exact_floor(line: symbol, terms: symbol, mode: symbol, sign: symbol, floor: number, side: symbol)
exact_floor(l, t, mode, sign, f, side) :- expected_line(l), signed_floor(l, sign, f),
expected_line__rounding_sha256(l, t), expected_line__currency(l, currency),
rounding(t), rounding__currency(t, currency), rounding__source_url(t, _),
rounding__boundary(t, "line"), rounding_mode(t, mode), rounding__minor_per_unit(t, units), units > 0,
word_cell(l, "units", 0, units), word_cell(l, "floor", 0, f),
digit_at(l, "numerator", 0), digit_at(l, "denominator", 0),
digit_at(l, "remainder", 0), digit_at(l, "gap", 0), gap_positive(l),
checked_equation(l, "division"), checked_equation(l, "complement"),
!bad_digits(l), !bad_words(l), !bad_carry(l), half_position(l, side).
.decl round_away(line: symbol, terms: symbol, sign: symbol, floor: number)
round_away(l, t, s, f) :- exact_floor(l, t, _, s, f, "above").
round_away(l, t, s, f) :- exact_floor(l, t, "half_up", s, f, "tie").
round_away(l, t, s, f) :- exact_floor(l, t, "half_even", s, f, "tie"),
half = f / 2, double = half * 2, f != double.
.decl verified_rounding(line: symbol, terms: symbol, minor: number)
verified_rounding(l, t, f) :- exact_floor(l, t, _, _, f, "below").
verified_rounding(l, t, f) :- exact_floor(l, t, "half_even", _, f, "tie"), half = f / 2, double = half * 2, f = double.
verified_rounding(l, t, m) :- round_away(l, t, "negative", f), m = f - 1.
verified_rounding(l, t, m) :- round_away(l, t, "nonnegative", f), m = f + 1.
